notes: NPC-0 §4 command 8 NPC_TRADE_INTENT and §5.5 (NPC_SINGLE_TRADE_COMMIT_V1); NPC trade shape only, the one-item DUR03-RL-01..08 and fee DUR03-RL-*-FEE-BURN rows are unchanged; registered by OTV2-20261013-npc-trade-1. BUY: up to 20 coin BURN lines of the gold fee plan (FeeBurnCause::NpcTrade), up to 2 change MINTs and the item MINT; SELL: one item BURN and up to 3 coin MINTs. E12 extends these existing BUY entries, without allocating resource IDs: only an admitted current-House Hireling package carrying exactly the donor's three children may use 26 touched items / 26 custody lines / 26 participants / 72 work units. The original 23/23/23/66 limits still apply to ordinary BUY. Container expansion is exactly 3 for a package and 0 otherwise; at most one existing bank value line remains allowed. Payload/envelope bytes map explicitly to existing DUR03-RL-07-NPC-SELL-ALL rows and are measured before mutation. See ../protocol-oteryn/v1/hireling-trade-and-audit-v1.md. The same rows admit the closed native furniture-kit BUY: 20 coin BURNs, two change MINTs and one kit MINT (23 item/custody/participant lines) plus one immutable house_wrap origin metadata write, at most 67 effect work units; the package maxima 26/26/26/72 already cover it. No Ground target receives Inventory admission.
